rules.title: Partner rules
items: Commission applies to every confirmed successful top-up made by a user who registered through your link.
Your personal rate is shown on this page. Commission uses the actual USD amount paid and does not stack with the standard referral reward.
Partner commission starts after Partner access is enabled; earlier payments are not recalculated.
Each commission is held for 7 days before becoming available.
Available commission can be transferred to API Credits or withdrawn. The minimum withdrawal is USD 20.
Withdrawals support Alipay and USDT on BNB Smart Chain (BEP-20). Check payout details carefully before submitting.
Only one withdrawal request may be pending at a time. RelayBases reviews and processes each request manually.
Refunded or disputed payments do not earn commission. Related commission may be reversed or deducted from future commission.

modelDescriptions.claude-fable-5: Claude Fable 5, Anthropic's most capable broadly released model for long-running agents, complex reasoning, coding, and research.
modelDescriptions.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001: Claude Haiku 4.5, a fast lightweight model for low-latency chat and batch tasks.
modelDescriptions.claude-opus-4-5-20251101: Claude Opus 4.5, a flagship reasoning model for complex coding and analysis.
modelDescriptions.claude-opus-4-6: Claude Opus 4.6, flagship reasoning and coding for long-context tasks.
modelDescriptions.claude-opus-4-7: Claude Opus 4.7, flagship reasoning for agents, coding, and research.
modelDescriptions.claude-opus-4-8: Claude Opus 4.8, latest Opus flagship for complex reasoning and code.
modelDescriptions.claude-opus-5: Claude Opus 5, an advanced Anthropic model for complex agentic coding and enterprise work, with deep reasoning and a 1M-token context window.
modelDescriptions.claude-sonnet-5: Claude Sonnet 5, a high-speed reasoning model for coding, agents, analysis, and 1M-token long-context workloads.
modelDescriptions.claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929: Claude Sonnet 4.5, balanced high performance for code, analysis, and agents.
modelDescriptions.claude-sonnet-4-6: Claude Sonnet 4.6, high-performance general model for code and long context.
modelDescriptions.codex-auto-review: Codex Auto Review, tuned for automated code review and repository checks, with separate standard and long-context pricing tiers.
modelDescriptions.deepseek-v4-flash: DeepSeek V4 Flash (DeepSeek-V4-Flash): 1M context, up to 384K output; supports non-thinking and thinking modes, with thinking enabled by default; supports JSON Output, Tool Calls, and chat prefix completion; FIM is supported only in non-thinking mode; concurrency limit 2500.
modelDescriptions.deepseek-v4-pro: DeepSeek V4 Pro (DeepSeek-V4-Pro): 1M context, up to 384K output; supports non-thinking and thinking modes, with thinking enabled by default; supports JSON Output, Tool Calls, and chat prefix completion; FIM is supported only in non-thinking mode; concurrency limit 500.
modelDescriptions.gemini-3.1-pro-high: Gemini 3.1 Pro high route for complex reasoning, code, and multimodal work.
modelDescriptions.gemini-3.1-pro-low: Gemini 3.1 Pro low route for complex reasoning, code, and multimodal work.
modelDescriptions.gemini-3.5-flash-high: Gemini 3.5 Flash high route for low-latency multimodal tasks.
modelDescriptions.gemini-3.5-flash-low: Gemini 3.5 Flash low route for low-latency multimodal tasks.
modelDescriptions.gemini-3.6-flash-high: Gemini 3.6 Flash high-thinking route for complex coding, agentic execution, and multimodal and spatial reasoning.
modelDescriptions.gemini-3.6-flash-medium: Gemini 3.6 Flash medium-thinking route, balancing speed and intelligence for general agentic and multimodal tasks.
modelDescriptions.gemini-3.6-flash-low: Gemini 3.6 Flash low-thinking route for low-latency agentic loops and high-volume multimodal tasks.
modelDescriptions.gpt-5.3-codex-spark: GPT-5.3 Codex Spark, low-latency coding for quick edits and refactors.
modelDescriptions.gpt-5.4: GPT-5.4, frontier general reasoning for complex code and long context.
modelDescriptions.gpt-5.4-mini: GPT-5.4 mini, cost-efficient reasoning for high-throughput tasks.
modelDescriptions.gpt-5.5: GPT-5.5, flagship general reasoning for complex professional work.
modelDescriptions.gpt-5.6-luna: GPT-5.6 Luna, a fast and cost-efficient model for high-volume, latency-sensitive tasks, with separate standard and long-context pricing tiers.
modelDescriptions.gpt-5.6-terra: GPT-5.6 Terra, a balanced model between the flagship Sol and cost-efficient Luna tiers for everyday coding, reasoning, and agentic tasks, with separate standard and long-context pricing tiers.
modelDescriptions.gpt-5.6-sol: GPT-5.6 Sol, the flagship of the GPT-5.6 series, excelling at complex reasoning, coding, and agentic workflows, especially strong at command-line and multi-step coding.
modelDescriptions.gpt-audio-1.5: GPT Audio 1.5, a general-purpose audio model for Chat Completions with audio input and output, streaming, and function calling.
modelDescriptions.gpt-image-2: GPT Image 2 supports image generation and editing through Azure image endpoints. Billing is based on actual usage, with a minimum charge of Ɍ0.08 per generated or edited image. If actual usage exceeds the minimum, actual usage billing applies. The console bill is authoritative.
modelDescriptions.gpt-realtime-2.1: GPT Realtime 2.1, a realtime reasoning model for advanced voice agents with improved alphanumeric recognition, silence and noise handling, interruption behavior, configurable reasoning, and tool use.
modelDescriptions.gpt-realtime-2.1-mini: GPT Realtime 2.1 mini, a faster, lower-cost distilled reasoning model for realtime voice interactions over WebRTC, WebSocket, or SIP, with tool use.
modelDescriptions.gpt-realtime-whisper: GPT Realtime Whisper, a streaming speech-to-text model for low-latency realtime transcription with incremental transcript updates and duration-based billing.
modelDescriptions.grok-4.5: Grok 4.5, SpaceXAI's frontier model for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work. It supports a 500K context window, text and image input, configurable reasoning, function calling, structured outputs, web search, X search, and code execution.
modelDescriptions.grok-4.6: Grok 4.6, SpaceXAI's frontier model for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work. It supports a 500K context window, text and image input, configurable reasoning, function calling, structured outputs, and prompt caching, with separate standard and long-context pricing.
modelDescriptions.grok-composer-2.5-fast: Composer 2.5 Fast, Cursor's first-party frontier coding-agent model delivered through Grok Build. The Fast route provides the same intelligence at lower latency, excelling at sustained long-running tasks, complex instruction following, tool use, file editing, and terminal work. Text-only; image input is not supported.
modelDescriptions.grok-imagine-edit: Grok Imagine synchronous image editing compatibility model. Use /v1/images/edits with 1-3 reference images. Ɍ0.08 is charged for each returned image.
modelDescriptions.grok-imagine-image-quality: Grok Imagine synchronous image generation and editing at 1K or 2K. Use /v1/images/generations or /v1/images/edits; editing supports up to 3 reference images. Ɍ0.08 is charged for each returned image.
modelDescriptions.grok-imagine-video: Grok Imagine Video supports five asynchronous modes through RelayBases /v1/videos: text-to-video, single-image-to-video, reference-to-video with 1-7 images, video editing with one MP4 up to 8.7 seconds, and 2-10 second video extension from a 2-15 second MP4. Generation supports 1-15 seconds, seven API aspect ratios, and 480p/720p; editing and extension inherit the source ratio and resolution up to 720p. Billing is Ɍ0.08 per second with no async x4 multiplier; editing uses verified source seconds and extension uses only the added duration.
modelDescriptions.grok-imagine-video-1.5: Grok Imagine Video 1.5 supports single-image-to-video generation as an asynchronous task only. Use /v1/videos with exactly one image, 1-15 seconds, and 480p, 720p, or 1080p output. Billing is Ɍ0.16 per generated second, with no async x4 multiplier.
modelDescriptions.nana-banana-2: Async image generation and editing. Supports up to 9 reference images; submit a task and poll for results. Async calls cost x4.
modelDescriptions.nana-banana-2_sync: Nana Banana 2 synchronous image generation and editing. Use /v1/images/generations and receive the final image in an OpenAI-compatible response.
modelDescriptions.nana-banana-pro: Async image generation and editing. Supports up to 9 reference images; submit a task and poll for results. Async calls cost x4.
modelDescriptions.nana-banana-pro_sync: Nana Banana Pro synchronous image generation and editing. Use /v1/images/generations and receive the final image in an OpenAI-compatible response.
modelDescriptions.veo-3-1: Fixed 8-second video generation. Supports text-to-video, first/last frames, and up to 9 reference images. Async calls cost x4.
modelDescriptions.veo-omni-flash: Fixed 10-second video generation with first/last frame and multi-image references. Supports up to 9 reference images. Async calls cost x4.
modelDescriptions.veo-omni-flash-video-edit: Video editing with one reference video and multiple reference images. Output is up to 10 seconds and constrained by the reference video. Async calls cost x4.
modelDescriptions.video-fast-480p: 4-15 seconds selectable; billed as duration times base unit price. Async calls cost x4. Supports image, video, and audio references.
modelDescriptions.video-fast-720p: 4-15 seconds selectable; billed as duration times base unit price. Async calls cost x4. Supports image, video, and audio references.
modelDescriptions.video-pro-480p: 4-15 seconds selectable; billed as duration times base unit price. Async calls cost x4. Supports image, video, and audio references.
modelDescriptions.video-pro-720p: 4-15 seconds selectable; billed as duration times base unit price. Async calls cost x4. Supports image, video, and audio references.
modelDescriptions.video-pro-1080p: 4-15 seconds selectable; billed as duration times base unit price. Async calls cost x4. Supports image, video, and audio references.
modelDescriptions.video-standard-720p: Fixed 15 seconds; billed as duration times base unit price. Async calls cost x4. Supports image, video, and audio references.
modelDescriptions.glm-5.1: GLM-5.1, Z.AI's flagship text model for long-horizon coding, complex agents, and structured reasoning.
modelDescriptions.glm-5.2: GLM-5.2, Z.AI's flagship model for long-horizon tasks, with usable 1M context and 128K max output for coding agents, project-scale engineering, and complex debugging.
modelDescriptions.glm-5.3: GLM-5.3, Z.AI's latest flagship text model for complex software engineering and agentic work. It supports a 1M context window, up to 128K output, always-on reasoning at low, high, or max effort, streaming, function calling, context caching, and structured outputs.
modelDescriptions.kimi-k2.6: Kimi K2.6, Moonshot's long-context model for coding, agents, and complex document tasks.
modelDescriptions.kimi-k2.7-code: Kimi K2.7 Code, Moonshot's coding-focused model for repository-level code, agentic programming, and long-context development.
modelDescriptions.kimi-k3: Kimi K3, Moonshot's flagship 1M-context model for long-horizon programming and end-to-end knowledge work, always reasoning with tool calls, structured output, and automatic context caching.
modelDescriptions.minimax-m3: MiniMax M3, a 1M-context model for long-horizon coding, agents, and text reasoning.
modelDescriptions.tts-1-hd: TTS-1 HD, a high-quality text-to-speech model for natural speech generation through the Audio API Speech endpoint.
